evidence: These tracks can be walked in either direction.
This description details the Caples then the Greenstone Track.
The Caples and Greenstone tracks start from the carpark at the end of Greenstone Road, 86 km from Queenstown, via Glenorchy.
Follow the Greenstone/Caples Track from the car park.
Here you join the Caples Track.
Trampers wishing to walk out to the car park should follow the track downstream for 30 minutes.

doubts: The start/end is 'the carpark at the end of Greenstone Road'; F2 is a road end on GREENSTONE STATION ROAD with an unnamed track, taken as that car park, but the road names differ slightly. The page says the tracks can be walked in either direction and describes Caples then Greenstone; whether that is clockwise or anticlockwise is not stated. No total distance is given (DOC distance is empty). Upper Caples Hut is listed as on this track but its position along the way is not described, so it is not placed in via. Steele Creek Lodge is a private hut the track passes close to. Lake Howden outlet on the Routeburn Track is given as an alternative start, reached in one hour from the Divide; the Divide ref F1 is the road end where the Routeburn Track meets the highway. The McKellar Hut to Lake Howden side trip is the same track the Lake Howden access uses.
